mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 2% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month, coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only if the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4%.
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 increases and FEDFUNDS < 4%.
